spans.s: 2 विद् (mostly —˚) knowing.
4 विद् (—˚) finding, winning, procuring.

विदग्धचूडामणि m. N. of a parrot (the
crest-jewel of the wise).
विदग्धता f. cleverness, skill in (loc.).
†विदत्र v. सुविद॑त्र.

विदथ्य॑ a. fit for a congregation or a council,
festive, solemn.
विद॑द्वसु a. winning good.
विदरण n. bursting, splitting.

विदारण a. (f. ई) & n. tearing or breaking asunder,
splitting, piercing, crushing, wounding.

†विदर्भ m. pl. N. of a people, sgl. the country or a
king of the V.
विदर्भनगरी f. city of Vidarbha, i.e. Kuṇḍina.
विदर्भपति m. king of Vidarbha.
विदर्भ˚राजन् m. king of Vidarbha.
विदर्भीकौण्डिन्य॑ m. N. of a teacher.
विदलन n. bursting, splitting (trans.).

विदान॑ a. existing, being, real;
 usual, common.
2 विदा॑न n. dividing.
विदार m. rending, tearing, or cutting asunder.
विदारक a. tearing asunder, lacerating (—˚).
विदारिन् a. = prec. a.
विदाहिन् a. heating, burning.
विदितधर्मन् a. knowing what is right.
विदितभक्ति a. knowing i.e. practising devotion.
विदितात्मन् a. knowing the soul or the self.
विदि॑श् f. intermediate region (north-east etc.).
विदिशा f. = prec., N. of a city & a river.
विदीर्ण a. burst, torn asunder, opened.

विदूर a. distant, remote. n. वि॑दूरम् far off, विदूरात्
or ˚रतस् from afar, also = ˚रे far away.
विदु॑स् a. attentive, mindful.
विदूरता f.*, ˚त्व n. great distance.
विदृति f. the suture on the head.
विदेघ॑ m. N. of a man.
विदेय a. to be given or granted.
1 वि॑देव a. godless, impious.
2 विदेव॑ m. dicing.
विदेवन n. the same.
विदेश m. a foreign country, abroad.
2 विदेह a. bodiless, dead, abstr. ˚त्व n.

विद्म॑न् n. attention, knowledge;
 dat. as infin.
1 †विद्य n. finding, getting.

2 विद्य (adj. —˚) = seq.;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

विद्या॑ f. knowledge, learning, a discipline or science, esp.
sacred knowledge (threefold) or magic, spell.
विद्यागुरु m. the teacher of a science.
विद्याग्रहण n. acquirement of knowledge.
विद्याधन n. the treasure of knowledge.
विद्याधार m. receptacle of knowledge, a great scholar.

विद्याधरमहाचक्रवर्तिन्^1 m. supreme
king of the Vidyādharas, abstr. ˚र्तिता f.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160419. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/290. note: cf MW, PW..

विद्याधरेन्द्र m. king of the Vidyādharas, abstr.
˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
विद्याधिगम m. the study of science.*
विद्यानुपालिन् a. keeping the hereditary science.
विद्याबल n. the power of magic.
विद्याभीप्सिन् a. desirous of knowledge.
विद्यामद m. pride in one's learning.
विद्यामय a. consisting in knowledge.

विद्यार्थ a. seeking for knowledge, desirous of
learning.

विद्या˚र्थिन् a. seeking for knowledge, desirous of
learning.
विद्यावन्त् a. having or knowing knowledge, learned.
विद्या˚विद् a. having or knowing knowledge, learned.
विद्यावयोवृद्ध a. advanced in learning and age.
विद्याहीन a. wanting knowledge, uninstructed.
विद्युत्य॑ a. relating to lightning.
विद्युद्दामन् n. flash of lightning.

विद्यु॑द्धस्त a. holding a glittering weapon in the
hand.
विद्यु॑न्मन् a. glittering, flashing.

विद्यु॑न्महस् a. having a glittering sheen or whose
delight is lightning.
विद्युन्माला f. garland of lightning, N. of a metre.

विद्युल्लता f. flash of lightning (lit. a creeper & a
line of lightning).

विद्युल्लेखा f. flash of lightning (lit. a creeper & a
line of lightning).
विद्योत a. & m. flashing, glittering.
विद्योतक a. illuminating.

विद्योतन a. = prec.;
 n. lightning.
विद्योतिन् a. illuminating (—˚).
विद्रव m. running asunder, flight, panic.
विद्राविन् a. running away, flying.
1 विद्रुम n. coral.
2 विद्रुम a. treeless.
विद्वज्जन m. a wise man.

विद्वत्ता^1 f. ˚त्त्व n. knowledge, learning.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf mw, also by gender.
विद्वल॑ a. knowing, cunning.
विद्विष् m. enemy, foe.

विद्विषन्त् a. hostile, averse;
 m. = prec.

विद्वि˚षाण a. hostile, averse;
 m. = prec.
विद्विष्टि f. hatred, enmity.

विद्वेष॑ m. = prec., aversion to (loc.), the being hated
by (—˚).
विद्वेषक a. hating, disliking (—˚).
विद्वेषिता f. hatred, enmity.

विद्वेषिन् a. hating, rivalling, inimical;
 m. hater, foe.
विद्वेष्य a. odious, hateful to (—˚).
